htzdistance.config.title: HtzDistance
htzdistance.config.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no ghosts are captured or drawn.
htzdistance.config.kind.enabled.descript: Keep showing this entity type after the server stops sending it.
htzdistance.config.kind.threshold.descri: Horizontal distance (blocks) at which the server stops sending this entity type. Defaults match the measured server: 16 for armor stands, 8 for item frames.
htzdistance.config.thresholdMargin.descr: Tolerance around the tracking range. An entity removed closer than (range - margin) is treated as destroyed, not as out of range.
htzdistance.config.inRangeTimeoutSeconds: If you stay inside the real range this long and the entity does not come back, its ghost is removed.
htzdistance.config.reconcileRadius.descr: Max distance between a ghost and a returning real entity to treat them as the same one.
htzdistance.config.learningMode.descript: Measures the real disappearance distance of each type while you play and uses it instead of the values above.
htzdistance.config.maxRenderDistance.des: Ghosts farther than this (blocks) are not drawn.
htzdistance.config.maxGhosts.description: Max number of ghosts kept per dimension. The farthest ones are dropped first.
htzdistance.config.occlusionCulling.desc: Skip ghosts hidden behind blocks, checked asynchronously on a background thread.
htzdistance.config.ghostStyle.descriptio: How ghosts look compared to real entities. On Minecraft 1.21.10 and later, Tinted and Translucent show ghosts with a glowing outline in the tint color.
htzdistance.config.tintColor.description: Color multiplied over ghosts with the Tinted style.
htzdistance.config.translucentAlpha.desc: Opacity of ghosts with the Translucent style.
htzdistance.config.persistence.descripti: Keep ghosts between sessions, stored per server and dimension.
htzdistance.config.debugLogging.descript: Log every capture, drop and reconciliation to the game log.
htzdistance.config.group.learned.descrip: Ranges measured on the server you are connected to. Used instead of the configured ones when learning mode is on.
htzdistance.config.learned.noServer: Join a server or world to see its learned ranges.
htzdistance.config.learned.notEnough: not enough data (%s removals, %s additions, need %s each)
htzdistance.config.learned.reset.descrip: Deletes the samples learned on this server. Reopen the screen to refresh the values.
